title: Wholesale inflation hits 12.29% in October 2026
takeaways: Headline WPI inflation rose to 12.29%, from 11.39% in September.
Fuel and power wholesale prices jumped 32.84% year on year.
Crude petroleum and natural gas prices were up 70.80%.
Retail CPI hit 6.09%, above the RBI's 6% upper limit.
source_note: Sources: MoCI WPI via Business Standard, Goodreturns, ETV Bharat; 16 Nov 2026
